about: What people on the East Isle say. First matching entry wins; the last has no condition.

say: {name}! MY CRYSTALS SPARKLE ON MY SHELF EVERY NIGHT.
SAY HELLO TO THE BATS AND SLIMES FOR ME! AND THEY SAY THERE'S STILL TREASURE AT THE FAR END OF THE MINE.
HELLO, {name}! I'M {@east-miner}. SEE THAT ROCKY SPOT WITH THE BOULDERS?
THAT STONE ARCH IS THE OLD MINE. WALK RIGHT IN! FOLLOW THE RAILS, AND THEY SAY THERE'S TREASURE AT THE FAR END.
HAVE YOU TRIED BAKER BUN'S TREATS? I'M DREAMING OF DONUTS!
